name: getInvoices
description: Get billing information and invoices for a customer account. Use this when the user asks about invoices, bills, billing history, or payment information.

name: endCall
description: Terminate the Call with the customer after the customer has confirmed they dont need any further assistance.

name: transferToAgent
description: Trigger a hand-off to a live agent, providing contextual slots and the reason for transfer.

slots.description: List of slot name/value pairs to pass to the agent.

process.description: The request type prompting the transfer.
